text:
emma: Quick check — I'm planning a recurring SI mentor office hours slot for Q2. Goal: give integrators a predictable place to ask onboarding + marketplace/hardware hookup questions. Need input on agenda, signup flow, and how we surface recordings.

raj: Love it. Can we keep it 45m + 15m follow-ups? Short demos + open Q&A works well. Also want a quick template to collect partner context ahead of time.

linda: +1 on 45/15. Recommend a 3-block agenda: 1) announce updates (marketplace/hw), 2) 10-15m mini-deep dive (auth, networking), 3) Q&A + action items.

jason: For signup, what about a simple Typeform with these fields: company, SI level (partner/regional/elite), current stage (pilot/prod), integration blocker? Then mentors can triage.

emma: Nice. I'll draft the form. We should also tag sessions for recordings: "marketplace", "onprem", "hw-integration" so partners can search.

carlos: We should require a short pre-read for hardware partners: network topology + GPU SKU. Otherwise engineering time gets wasted.

raj: Agreed. Also propose a 2-week rolling slot for mentor shadowing: SI engineers can request a 1:1 to shadow a Redwood engineer on an onboarding call. Limits: 2 shadow slots per week.

linda: Good. We should codify mentor responsibilities in a 1-pager (handbook) — what we will and won't do during office hours vs. shadow calls.

emma: I'll own the handbook draft. Draft outline: purpose, session types (office hours / shadow / async review), pre-reqs, escalation path, recordkeeping, and certification touchpoints.

jason: For recordkeeping — can we link sessions to partner profiles in Salesforce? Even a note field with "SI-office-hours: <date>" is helpful for AE handoffs.

carlos: Also add a short checklist for HW partners: public IPs, firewall rules, NTP, SMP config, and GPU driver versions. We can attach as gist.

mentor-bot: Reminder: calendar slot created for recurring office hours, Wednesdays 10:00–11:00 PT starting 2025-04-02. Signup: https://forms.gle/example-signup (auto-confirm).

emma: Thanks bot. Plan for first session: intro to Redwood Dedicated + Marketplace listing process. Linda — can you do the 15m mini-deep-dive on onboarding checklist?

linda: Yep, I'll prep a 10-slide deck and a one-page checklist. Will share slide link by EOD Friday.

raj: I'll add a short certification pathway note — micro-credentials for SI engineers: "Redwood Integrator: Essentials" (online quiz + 2 shadow calls) — good gate for priority support.

emma: Love that. Add a badge we can use on partner profiles. Jason, can you wire up the badge in the partner portal?

jason: Yup. Need the image (svg) and the criteria doc. I'll stub the portal badge and show in next sync.

carlos: One more ask — for hardware partners we should provide a minimal pre-provision script. Example: 
```#!/bin/bash
apt update && apt install -y nfs-common
# mount shared home for cache
mount -t nfs 10.0.0.5:/cache /mnt/cache
```
Share as a gist and link in the handbook.

emma: Perfect. Action items summary: 
- Emma: create Typeform, start handbook draft, publish sessions tags.
- Linda: slides + 1-pager checklist (due Fri EOD).
- Raj: write certification pathway draft + criteria.
- Jason: stub portal badge, integrate SFDC note template.
- Carlos: create pre-provision gist and hardware checklist.
- Mentor-bot: publish recurring calendar + auto-confirm signup.

raj: Can we schedule a rehearsed dry-run the week before kickoff? 30m to walk through flow, handoffs, and recording permissions.

emma: Yes — I'll create a dry-run event and invite the people above. Tentative dry-run: 2025-03-26 10:00 PT.

linda: One more thought — make recordings auto-trimmed to 60s highlights (ops team has a tool). We can surface highlights in the handbook and in the partner newsletter.

carlos: If editing is onerous, at least add timestamps in the notes for key segments.

emma: Solid. I'll add a 'highlights & timestamps' section in the handbook template.

mentor-bot: Note: recordings stored in Partners Drive -> "SI Office Hours" folder. Access set to partners-readonly via shared link.

jason: I'll create the SFDC note template and post the link here when done.

emma: Thanks everyone. I'll post the Typeform + handbook first draft in this thread by Thursday. If no objections, we go live with the recurring slot. :rocket:

raj: No objections from me. Excited for this.

linda: LGTM.

carlos: Works for me.

emma: Closing thread — will ping again when draft is up.
